GC 1020 - Introduction to Digital Graphics
Credit Hours: 2
Introduces digital graphics tools and workflows.
Preq: None.

GC 3460 - Ink and Substrates
Credit Hours: 3
Study of printing inks and substrate interactions.
Preq: GC 2070 with a C or better.

GC 4400 - Commercial Printing
Credit Hours: 4
Lithographic and digital commercial printing processes.
Preq: GC 3460 and GC 3400, each with a C or better.
